title: Todos of Rome
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Berakhot 19a: “Rav Yosef taught: Todos of Rome accustomed the people of Rome to eat kids roasted whole in the paschal style on the nights of Passover (abroad). Shimon ben Shetach sent to him: Were you not Todos, I would decree a ban upon you.” In Pesachim 53a the statement is cited, and there it does not mention who sent to him. They asked there whether Todos was a great man or a violent man, and they said: “Come and hear: This too Todos of Rome expounded: What did Chananyah, Mishael and Azaryah see that they gave themselves up for the sanctification of the Name?” etc. Rabbi Yose bar Avin said that he used to provide business capital for Torah scholars.
So it is in the Jerusalem Talmud, Pesachim, beginning of chapter 7: he used to assist the sages with their livelihood.

notes.text: מקולסין means kids roasted whole in the paschal style. Saved Davidson Pesachim53b discusses both that practice and Todos providing business capital to scholars; the supplied53a locator remains. Hyman’s abridgment is not silently expanded into the whole narrative.

The consulted Davidson English Pesachim 53b discusses Todos/Theodosius as a scholar or violent man, his fiery-furnace homily and business capital for scholars. Hyman supplies 53a and a compressed narrative; his locator and wording remain. This English contextual witness is not a newly inspected Hebrew or printed edition.
